spans.text: A sudden power outage has occurred on the outskirts of Berlin in an area that spans almost the entirety of the Green Zone.
Over 400,000 people are affected by the blackout as it halts operations of businesses and medical facilities...
We will now hand over to Shadowless, who is reporting on-site...
Thank you. From this relatively elevated position, we can see that this entire area has gone dark.
Many residents affected by the power cut have left their homes and gone out into the streets...
A conflict seems to have broken out in that neighborhood. There is a lot of clamor, but we can't see much due to the poor visibility. I will try to get down there for a closer look...
It's too dangerous down there. The main station advises against approaching...
Dangerous? Alright, then we'll just have to rely on the latest information provided by the police.
